list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, reported 18 November 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Guides below are written for this entry, in its own words, and cite their sources.

notes.cheats: Using cheats disables trophies and saving (PowerPyx, GTABase). Leave cheats off for a trophy run; cheats only unlock after the story in any case.
notes.missable: Only Positive Mental Attitude is reported as possibly missable (PowerPyx, GTABase): its first meditation spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is said to become unavailable after that chapter. No other trophy is reported missable at launch.
notes.noReplay: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus (PowerPyx). Free roam continues after the story, and almost everything else can still be done then. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
notes.online: All 55 trophies are single-player. There are no online trophies at launch (PowerPyx).
notes.time: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum, with one playthrough enough. The story takes roughly 60-80 hours.

roadmap.text: Turn the spoiler setting on if you want story trophies hidden until you earn them. Then start the habit that protects the whole run: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission, because there is no mission replay. Do the first meditation the moment it is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — it is the one spot reported to vanish after the chapter, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Leave cheats off: they switch trophies off.
roadmap.title: Before you start: saves, spoilers, the one missable

roadmap.text: Play the story straight through. Every chapter trophy and every named-mission trophy unlocks as you finish that chapter or mission, and the gold for the final mission closes the story. While you play, scan vehicles and study animals through the binoculars whenever you pass them: the 100% checklist counts 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress you bank now still counts later. Take stranger missions as they appear instead of leaving them all for the end.
roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 1 to 5 and the final mission

roadmap.text: After the story, finish the stranger strands: eight of them for Strangers & Freaks, and the final mission of each strand for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Hunt the unique animal for Bret. These are all still open in free roam after the credits.
roadmap.title: Strangers and side missions

roadmap.text: Work the long counters: WAiNK It at 100 locations, three collectible card sets, all 18 meditation spots, 100 vehicles discovered, every area of Leonida explored, every garage property bought, and 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. None of these is missable, and all of it feeds the 100% checklist.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploring Leonida

roadmap.text: Clear the activity counters: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone race win at every one of the 14 locations, 20 different races won, a fishing win against Cal, one arcade game finished, and 50 challenges done. You only need 70 of the 80 challenges for 100% completion, so you can skip the hardest ones. Chase the cryptic one-off trophies last, when you know the map: the cocktail on Ocean Beach, the bowling alley, the showroom smash, and the rest.
roadmap.title: Activities, challenges and one-off moments

roadmap.text: Finish the robbery set with your partner beside you: three shops back-to-back, five bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store without being spotted, and one illegal operation for each gang. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills and spend $100,000 across the shops. Then open the 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion) and mop up whatever it still lists. A Long Road is the last gold before the platinum, and the platinum itself pops the moment the other 54 are done.
roadmap.title: Crime, money and 100% completion

trophies.guide: This is the reward for everything else: it unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers, collectibles, activities, and the 100% checklist — and this pops at the end. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn, and it cannot be missed — just play the story from the start.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, do the meditation at Jason's house: PowerPyx reports it as the one missable moment in the game, because it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is said to disappear once Chapter 1 ends. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you need to go back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. From this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up most of the side content, so take stranger missions and activities as they appear rather than saving them all for after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start to open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, keep your partner close when you rob shops and vaults — several of those trophies need your partner beside you.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, and a save here is your safety net for anything story-related.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is one of only two gold trophies in the set, and it closes the story: free roam continues afterwards, so anything you have not finished yet can still be done. Keep the manual save you made before it, just in case.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. It unlocks by playing the story in order, so there is nothing extra to find — just keep following the mission markers.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist, so it comes to you as the story reaches it; play the missions in order and it will unlock on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks by finishing that mission in the story, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy follows; there is no collectible or side task attached to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in order; the airport itself is also the place for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so remember the layout when you come back in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks; it is one of the later story missions, so it comes near the end of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. PowerPyx reports the thresholds are lenient — closer to 60% of everything in the game: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and only 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. This is the hardest trophy in the set and the last gold before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total, and the counter keeps running through the whole playthrough. The fastest way is to fold stunts into everything else: jump the ramps you pass while driving between missions instead of grinding them in one sitting. PowerPyx counts this among the long activity grinds, not the hard ones.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish any of them. GTABase, via GGRecon, lists nine types; the quickest route is to sample one of each as you meet it in the world (a race, a shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, and the rest) instead of hunting them down in one trip.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has its own set of challenges, so work through them range by range and learn one weapon's rhythm at a time rather than jumping between ranges. The gold thresholds are reported to be forgiving, and the ranges are all still open in free roam after the story, so this is a cleanup trophy, not a race.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 locations, so expect several races per spot; you only need one win at each location, not every race. Learn each course's tight corners first with a slow run, then race it for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race twice only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat, air) and keep a note of which you have won; the counter is per event, and all of them stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the bigger catch than Cal in the same session. Take the best rod and bait you can buy first, watch the tension so the line does not snap, and retry the challenge if Cal out-fishes you — it can be attempted again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — any machine, any game. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; pick the shortest game on the machine you find first and play it to its end screen. It also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand of stranger missions, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands are marked on the map as they appear; follow Andy's chain to its last mission and complete it. Like the other character finals, it stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand of stranger missions, ending with his final mission. Work through his missions in order as they appear on the map; the trophy pops when the last one is done. It also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand of stranger missions, ending with his final mission. Billy's chain is one of the five named character strands; complete each of his missions as it unlocks and the trophy follows the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as markers around the map; each strand is a short chain, and finishing all of its missions counts one strand. The five named character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of the same system, so work strands as you meet them and this silver lands on the eighth. PowerPyx puts the stranger cleanup at about 10 hours after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand of stranger missions, ending with his final mission. Follow his chain on the map through to its last mission; the trophy pops on completion and the strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand of stranger missions, ending with his final mission. Complete his missions in order as they appear; the last one closes his chain and unlocks the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase both flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is reported to become unavailable after that chapter, so do it the moment it is offered and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. The other spots stay open in free roam, so after Chapter 1, work through the remaining locations at your own pace.
trophies.missableNote: Reported possibly missable: the first meditation spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is said to become unavailable after that chapter (PowerPyx, GTABase). Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's quests are part of the stranger system, and PowerPyx lists them among the tasks that need to be finished in full for 100% completion. Track the animal with the binoculars first — studying animals also feeds the 100% checklist, which needs 100 of 255 studied — then take the shot when you have a clear one.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any three collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set needs every card in it, so pick three sets and collect them fully rather than scattering across all of them. Use the in-game collection screen to see which cards you still need, and fold card hunting into your exploration of each area.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the in-game photo-sharing action: open it at a new spot, snap the location, and the counter moves. Fold this into exploring the map for The Goodtime State — photograph each new area as you arrive and the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals scattered across activities and the open world; there are 80 in total, and you only need 50 for this trophy — 70 for 100% completion. Pick the easy ones first (driving, shooting, exploration) and skip the hardest; the counter keeps every challenge you have ever finished.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it — break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it in a quiet part of the map with a fast car ready, and do not rob anything mid-escape: the goal is to vanish, not to fight. This pairs naturally with the partner robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: you must keep the heat the whole way. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without hiding or switching cars. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving or scanning a new model adds it to your collection, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this is the first half of a longer job. Scan every unfamiliar car, bike, boat and plane you pass during the story and you will be most of the way there before cleanup.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one use of Combat Focus, take down five enemies. Wait for a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a police chase with several officers close together — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills before it runs out. Thin groups will not do it: you need five targets in range of a single activation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport by an unscheduled route — in plain terms, take a plane out without going through the normal departure. Get to the airfield, take an aircraft, and get airborne from VCIA itself; the trophy is about the exit, so any plane that lifts off from the airport grounds counts.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into the thick of it with Rhino tanks. The description is a joke about the heat inside a tank, and the trophy is the game's nod to tangling with Rhinos — steal one or survive an encounter with one in free roam. Military areas and high wanted levels are where Rhinos show up, so come armed and expect a fight.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarm, no witness spotting you. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when the staff's back is turned, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a clean run is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the getaway before you go in, with a fast car parked close and a route out of the search area. You do not need all five in one session — the counter keeps every vault you have robbed and escaped from.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — follow one until it stops, block it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A quiet stretch of road beats a busy one: fewer witnesses, fewer police on top of you.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the keys. The counter tracks named areas you have visited, so drive the map edge to edge and step into each new place until it registers. Pair this with WAiNK It at 100 locations and vehicle discovery: one road trip can move all three counters at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gangs run their own off-the-books operations around the state; find one per gang, hit it, and get out. Work the map gang by gang and tick them off — you need every gang covered, not just several hits on the same one.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach and enjoy it there. No guide published at launch pins down the exact bar or the exact trigger — PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet — so the honest advice is: go to the Ocean Beach waterfront, find a bar with a view, and order a drink. Check the sources linked here for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through the glass of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. No guide published at launch pins down the exact showroom, so the honest advice is: pick a showroom with a big glass front, get up speed inside, and smash out. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet; check the sources linked here for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there. Bowling is one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that counter can be done in the same visit. Roll a full game rather than a single ball: follow-through means seeing the game through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Do something with your partner that the whole state notices — the description points to a shared moment with Lucia or Jason that earns attention far beyond the two of you. No guide published at launch confirms the exact trigger, so this entry does not invent one: the likeliest reading is a partner activity done in public, and the sources linked here are where a confirmed method will appear first.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choices the game offers — and live with them. This trophy is about decisions rather than a single action, and no guide published at launch confirms how many choices it takes or which ones count. Play the story and the stranger missions, take the forks when they come, and the trophy should follow the decisions you have already made; check the sources linked here for a confirmed count as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try at something that beat you the first time. The description is a wink at failing once and then getting it right, and no guide published at launch confirms the exact activity it watches — PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed method yet. The practical advice: when you fail a challenge or activity, retry it at once instead of walking away; the retry is the point.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the kind of one-off oddity Leonida hides off the main path. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet, so no honest guide can give you an address at launch. Explore the odd corners of the map, the places that look out of place, and check the sources linked here: this is the trophy other players' discoveries will solve first.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — ride past on a bike or lean out of a moving vehicle and hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon, bowling-pin style. No guide published at launch confirms the exact setup, so take the description at its word: speed, a melee weapon in hand, and a target you can clip as you pass. Do it away from heavy police patrols so you can ride off after.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies all pay in them — and your contacts wash them into clean cash. Keep robbing and keep laundering: the total is cumulative, so every vault and truck moves the counter.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car parts, all of it counts. Buy what you actually need as you play (ammo, armor, better guns) and the counter climbs on its own; if you are short at the end, the fastest top-up is expensive clothing or vehicle upgrades. The total is cumulative across every shop.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages appear for sale as you explore; buy each one when you can afford it, and use the map to check which are still unowned. Garages also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them before you start collecting cars in earnest.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app, and register it — each new vehicle counts once, so you need ten different ones. Use the cars you already discovered for Whip It Good: drive them, register them, and both counters move together.
trophies.name: On the Spot
